title: Reel Nice Surprise

services.name: Maine Fishing
services.desc: Experience Maine’s coastal waters with a chance to pursue three very different game fish in one outing. Striped bass bring powerful runs close to shore, bluefish are known for their aggressive strikes, and sea-run brown trout offer a completely different challenge. Guide Jeff Trudeau can help you make the most of changing conditions as you work the waters around Wells and the Gulf of Maine. The trip includes the required fishing license, so you can focus on learning, casting, and enjoying the day without worrying about the essentials. services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: When the sun dips below the horizon and most boats head back to dock, that's when the real action begins. Captain Jeff Trudeau's 6-hour night striped bass charter from Wells Harbor isn't for weekend warriors-this is serious fishing for anglers who know their way around a rod. Starting at 6:30 PM, you'll spend the night targeting trophy stripers in some of Maine's most productive waters. With space for just three anglers, this world-class experience gives you the personal attention and prime positioning needed to land fish that most people only dream about.
